ox.secret.add.description: Ask the person to add or replace a typed secret in a native card: `await ox.secret.add({ purpose, key, type, serviceID? })`. type is account ({ username, password }), apiKey, or token; serviceID names the owning service, such as web:accounts.google.com. The value is never a JavaScript argument or result. For model provider credentials, use ox.provider.authenticate instead.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.secret.delete.description: Ask the person to delete a secret and clear its connections: `await ox.secret.delete({ purpose, key })`.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.secret.list.description: List secret metadata without exposing values: `await ox.secret.list({ purpose })`. Returns each secret's key, displayName, sorted JSON field names in fields, available status, type (account, apiKey, token, or null when it needs setup), and owning serviceID.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

fields.description: Sorted top-level field names only; empty when unavailable. Never secret values.
